info.title: BILL Spend & Expense Universal API
info.description: Manage BILL Spend & Expense budgets, users, cards, transactions, and reimbursements.

post.description: Adds a receipt to a reimbursement in BILL Spend & Expense.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

reimbursementId.description: BILL-generated ID or UUID of the reimbursement.

url.description: Uploaded receipt URL returned by the reimbursement upload URL flow.

post.description: Creates a new budget in BILL Spend & Expense.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

owners[].description: List of BILL-generated user IDs or UUIDs of budget owners. You must specify at least one budget owner.

recurringInterval.description: Interval after which the budget is reset.

limit.description: Spend limit for the initial budget period. Required unless limitless overspend is enabled.

recurringLimit.description: Spend limit for all future budget periods. Required when recurring interval is not NONE.

post.description: Creates a new reimbursement in BILL Spend & Expense.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

budgetId.description: BILL-generated ID of the budget used for the reimbursement.

customFields[].description: Custom field objects and values for the reimbursement.

occurredDate.description: Expense date in yyyy-MM-dd format, for example 2026-10-15.

userId.description: BILL-generated ID of the user to be reimbursed.

receiptUrl.description: Use the upload URL returned by Create Reimbursement Upload URL after uploading the JPG or PNG receipt image to that URL.

receiptFilename.description: Receipt file name with extension, for example receipt.jpg or receipt.png. BILL stores this together with the uploaded receipt URL.

recurringLimit.description: Card spend limit for all future budget periods when the assigned budget is recurring.
